stage2_correction.reason: The Amharic gloss for Ge'ez 'ተለዓለ' (he was lifted up / ascended) is 'ከፍ ፡ አለ' (he rose high), where the left stroke of 'ከ' was misread as 'አ'.

When joined across the line break with ችሁ on L02, the word is ከሻችሁ ('if you desire/seek [salvation]'). Visually, the glyph at the end of L01 is ሻ (fourth-order ሸ), not ኛ.

stage2_correction.reason: The word split across lines 11-12 is ኀቲም (signet/seal ring, paired with ቀለበቱን). The 1st-order Fidel ኀ was misread as ሖ.
Both visually (the bottom loop of the Ethiopic numeral ፵ = 40) and biblically (Pharaoh's elevation of Joseph is in Genesis 41:40-45), the numeral is ፵ rather than ፴.

ባል ፡ ሰው ፡ አለ ፡ ይላቸዋል ፡ አዎን ፡ እኔ፡

ትቼ ፡ ብሎ ፡ እሱን ፡ ይዞ ፡ ተመለሰ ፡ እነ
ነው ፡ አሉት ፡ በዚህ ፡ ደስ ፡ አለው ፡ የግ
ምን፡ ያህል ፡ አገኝ ፡ ብሎ ፤ ዘፍጥ ፡ ፵፭ ፥ ፪።

stage2_correction.reason: The verse numeral printed on the page is ፪ (2), referring to Genesis 45:2 (and 45:16), which was misread as ፬ (4).

stage2_correction.reason: In the image at Col 4 L14, the first word after ሳዝኑት ፡ is 'አለ' (first-order አ, meaning 'He said', introducing an alternative gloss), not 'እለ'. And the next word is 'አድሮባችሁ' (with 7th-order ሮ 'አድሮባችሁ ፡ ያለ ፡ መንፈስ ፡ ቅዱስን', meaning 'the Holy Spirit who dwells in you'), where the top loop of ሮ was misread as 6th-order ር.

Both the printed glyph in Col 4 L28 and canonical Ge'ez Acts 9:2 read ውቁሐኒሆሙ ('bound/fettered', from ወቀሐ / ውቁሕ), where Stage 1 misread the initial 6th-order ው as መ.

The printed glyph is ፅ (6th order ፀ with the central crossbar), matching the Ge'ez root ኅሩይ/ምርፅ.

stage2_correction.reason: The word is የታመመ ('who was sick', contrasting with የዳነበትን 'when he was healed' on the next line); ink bleed on the second መ made it look like ቸ.
Both legs of 1st-order ነ are clearly visible in የዳነበትን ('the time in which he was healed').
The word is የታመመ ('that he was sick for eight years'), matching the parallel phrase in Column 1 Line 33.

stage2_correction.reason: The Ge'ez conjunction 'እንዘ' (while, translated 'ሳለሁ' in L31) is printed with the 6th-order 'እ', which was misread as 1st-order 'አ'.
In Acts 11:5, the Ge'ez participle is 'ወእኅዝ' (and held/bound by its four corners, rendered 'የተያዘ' in L04). The middle glyph 'ኅ' was visually confused with 'ት'.

stage2_correction.reason: Classical Ge'ez plural of ካልእ is ካልኣን (4th-order ኣ), matching the shorter left leg of ኣ visible in the print.
Classical Ge'ez plural form ወካልኣን (4th-order ኣ) is printed on the page and required by grammar.
The printed scripture citation is ፩ ፡ ቆሮ ፡ ፲፭፥፲፪ (1 Corinthians 15:12, concerning the resurrection from the dead); the tightly spaced numerals ፲፭ were misread as ፬.
